payload.title: Park uncommitted main changes and file tasks to land them
payload.description: Park the uncommitted changes on main onto a temp branch, work out why each change was made, group them into tasks, then work and land those tasks until main is clean.
payload.context: This repo is a dependency of Endless. Mike's goal (2026-10-17, during go-cliutil E-2289) is a clean set of Endless dependencies. Endless builds against this repo's working tree through a local replace, so check whether parking the changes breaks the Endless build first; if it does, the resulting tasks block whatever they would break.

fields.plan:
# Plan: Park uncommitted main changes and file tasks to land them

The main checkout of go-dt has uncommitted work (staged and unstaged) that predates this task. Endless and other repos build against that working tree through local `replace` directives. The goal is a clean main, with every change either landed through a task or deliberately dropped by Mike.

The changes at filing time (2026-10-17), excluding `.endless/`:
- Modified: path_segments_ext.go, dtx/test/go.mod.
- Untracked: dtx/go.sum.
- go-dt is foundational. go-cliutil, go-doterr's sync tool and Endless all depend on it, so check its importers when analyzing.

## Steps
1. **Snapshot without touching main.** From this task's worktree, read the main checkout's full diff against HEAD, staged and unstaged together, including deletions, binaries and untracked non-`.endless/` files. Recreate it on a branch named `wip/<task-id>` cut from main's HEAD, and commit it there as one commit with message "WIP snapshot of main working tree". Then confirm the branch's tree matches main's working tree file for file. Don't use `git stash`; the stash stack is shared across sessions.
2. **Analyze.** Go through the snapshot and work out why each change was made, from the code, nearby commits and other repos that depend on it. Group the changes into coherent units, such as "API rename following go-dt v0.5.0", "new feature X" or "dependency bumps". Flag anything that looks unfinished, accidental, or like a generated or binary artifact.
3. **Report to Mike before filing.** Show the grouping, what each group is for, and anything you couldn't explain, then let him adjust it.
4. **File one task per agreed group** in this project. Each plan names the files and hunks it takes from `wip/<task-id>`.
5. **Check whether Endless depends on the WIP.** Build Endless against this repo at main HEAD, without the WIP, using a scratch GOWORK that points this module at a clean checkout. Add blockers for whatever fails: each group whose removal breaks the build gets `--blocks` on the tasks that need it.
6. **Hand Mike one command to clear main's working tree.** He runs it himself, only after confirming `wip/<task-id>` holds everything. This session doesn't write to the main checkout.

## Done when
Every change in the snapshot belongs to a filed task or is listed as "drop" with Mike's agreement, main is clean, and any build dependency is recorded as a blocker.

payload.title: Release go-dt's changed modules leaves-first
payload.description: Release each go-dt module whose contents changed since its last tag (root, dtx, appinfo, dtglob) with requires on published tags, showing the user each tag and its reason before pushing
payload.context: Found 2026-10-24: root v0.6.0 lacks PathSegments.IsRoot(); dtx/v0.2.1 (2025-11-18) does not compile against go-dt v0.6.0 (undefined: dt.ErrFileDoesNotExist), with 25 files changed since; appinfo/v0.2.1 and dtglob/v0.2.1 have 7 and 9 files changed since. All three submodules require stale go-dt versions (v0.5.0, v0.3.2) and build only through their in-repo replace. go-cliutil's release needs dtx (and maybe appinfo) tags that fit go-dt v0.6.0+. The tagging process is being worked out with the user in the go-cliutil release task; plan this after it settles.

fields.context:
Found 2026-10-24: root v0.6.0 lacks PathSegments.IsRoot(); dtx/v0.2.1 (2025-11-18) does not compile against go-dt v0.6.0 (undefined: dt.ErrFileDoesNotExist), with 25 files changed since; appinfo/v0.2.1 and dtglob/v0.2.1 have 7 and 9 files changed since. All three submodules require stale go-dt versions (v0.5.0, v0.3.2) and build only through their in-repo replace. The tagging process is being worked out with the user in the go-cliutil release task; plan this after it settles.

What go-cliutil's release needs (from its release task): go-cliutil requires go-dt root, dtx and appinfo, not dtglob. It builds against go-dt v0.6.0 and needs nothing newer from the root (it does not use IsRoot). It needs published dtx and appinfo tags whose go.mod require go-dt >= v0.6.0 with no replaces, and whose code compiles against v0.6.0.

go-dt's .github/workflows/release.yml (workflow_dispatch, version input) validates the version against ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-...)?$, so it cannot make directory-prefixed tags such as dtx/v0.3.0. It takes its previous tag from `git tag -l --sort=-v:refname | head -n 1` over all tags, which would mix prefixed and root tags. go-cliutil's release.yml has the same prefix restriction.
